title: 📊 Daily Report: Fri Nov 27, 2026
text:
Weekly wrap (Fri): the swing book closed at $17,273.86, +$687.34 on the week vs the prior Friday's close. The week PASSED the weekly rule: the strategies were +$9.31 vs the week base. CORE QQQ added +$678.03 of the week's gain. Today was a half-day, and the swing bots sat out (SPY below its 200-day average, volatility 32%), so no strategy trades.
Vs SPY (Indy) since the merge: book -$2,746.88 (-13.72%) vs Indy -$1,278.40 (-6.38%), a gap of -$1,468.48. Indy is $18,744.28.
Week gap vs SPY: the book gained +$687 while Indy gained about $982 (estimate), so we trailed by about $295. The parts: strategies +$9 (small); CORE in cash 0 this week (the month-end rule has it ON, with the Oct 30 close of 690.49 above the 200-day of 678.37); QQQ vs SPY and the vol-scale shortfall (CORE at 49% of the book, below full weight) account for most of the gap, but I could not split these two cleanly (estimate); late fills from box pauses were small and are not separately measured (execution-fidelity matched no fills today). Since the Nov 16 switch, CORE is -1.71% vs SPY -2.62% (+0.92 pp) and vs the old daily rule that sat in cash (-1.71 pp).
Bots that traded today: none in the live book. CORE QQQ: trend ON, held (the 9:31 AM open buy was skipped on a post-freeze catch-up tick, then retried; the book holds $8,458 of QQQ).
Benched shadow bots: real positions still running off: Trek, Rota and Sunny: 1 open position in the book. Shadow trades today: Trek 0, Rota 1 (1 on time, 0 late), Sunny 0. Since Nov 16: Trek 13 (7 on-time, 6 late), Rota 9 (4/5), Sunny 5 (0 on-time, 5 late).
Engine timing: first tick 9:31 AM ET (fine), but the box had 12 missed/late ticks in market hours today (148.9 min total, longest 28 min around the 12:38 PM tick, with no tick between 12:38 and 1:06 PM near the 1:00 PM early close). The box then had gaps of up to 89 min after the close. The CORE open buy was skipped once (9:31 AM, 10.5 min catch-up gap) and retried. No other trades were delayed.
Desktop shadow: DIFFERENCES: 1 box-only (the CORE open skip at 9:31 AM, which lines up with the post-freeze catch-up tick), 0 DIFF, 0 TIMING, 0 desktop-only; the rest matched (3 of 3 matched). Desktop heartbeat 7 min old; code versions MATCH (20261125-2051-27066a4553c2, updater current). Parity: book identical, inputs equal, no config drift, no ALERTs. Host flags: reboot pending and AutoAdminLogon off. Freeze cost today: box +$227.43, desktop +$227.43, diff $0.00; running total -$8.25 over 5 days. Tonight's re-seed was staged and pushed (seed-2026-11-27-180053, valid until Mon Nov 30 9:25 AM ET).
Research note (Research, Nov 27): The S&P 500 rose 1.6% Friday to 7,297, +5.6% on the week, its best since April 2025. Chips led the bounce, but Nvidia rose only 0.8%. The AI-hardware avoid stays on, with a formal review at Monday's close. No new longs this week. Risks next week: possible fund selling of up to $100B, and a Fed hike priced for Dec 8-9. Next up: ISM Tuesday, Salesforce Wednesday, the jobs report Friday.

Claude impact: nothing new today. The Nov 24 batches (CORE stop review and other ideas) are logged. The CEO adopted atomic ledger writes, a dead-man watchdog and a daily live-vs-lab fill log, all shipping after the Dec 3 cutover, and the stop fixes shipped Nov 25 but the desktop rolled them back. No measured P&L effect yet.
